answer: The design leans on succinct non-interactive computational proofs attesting to execution honesty. Every claim climbs the meadow of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the wander re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a vigilant tone, structured argument with focus on edge-case elimination register, it stays short. The vine of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
